chunks: On this day also, the Sheikh, the jurist, Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us. He said: Ja'far b. Salama narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us. He said: Ubaydullah b. Musa al-Absi narrated to us. He said: Muhalhil al-Abdi narrated to us. He said: Kudayra b. Salih al-Hijri narrated to us from Abu Dharr Jundub b. Junada (may Allah be pleased with him). He said:

I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family) say three phrases to Ali (peace be upon him); each of which, if I had but one, would be more beloved to me than the world and all that is in it. I heard him say: O Allah! Assist him and assist others through him. O Allah! Support him and gain victory through him, for indeed he is Your servant and the brother of Your Messenger. Then Abu Dharr (may Allah have mercy on him) said: I bear witness to the allegiance, brotherhood, and deputyship of Ali.

And Kudayra b. Salih said: Salman al-Farisi, al-Miqdad, Ammar, Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari, Abu al-Haytham b. al-Tayhan, Khuzayma b. Thabit the possessor of the two testimonies, Abu Ayyub the owner of the house of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family), and Hashim b. Utba al-Mirqal would also bear witness to the like of that for him. All of them were from the best of the companions of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family).

key_terms.الإخاء: Brotherhood (ikhaa) — referring to the special brotherhood established between the Prophet and Ali
key_terms.الوصية: Deputyship/testament (wasiyya) — Ali's designation as the Prophet's successor and executor of his will
key_terms.الولاء: Allegiance and loyalty (walaa) — here meaning devotion and fealty to Ali's authority
key_terms.ذو الشهادتين: Bearer of Two Testimonies — title of Khuzayma b. Thabit, whose testimony was counted as that of two witnesses by the Prophet
key_terms.عبدك وأخو رسولك: Your servant and the brother of Your Messenger — the Prophet's description of Ali's dual station before Allah

ai.seo_question: What three phrases did the Prophet say about Ali according to Abu Dharr, and which companions bore witness?
ai.summary: Abu Dharr al-Ghifari relates that the Prophet spoke three phrases about Ali, each one of which Abu Dharr considered more precious than the world: a supplication for divine assistance, support, and the acknowledgment that Ali is Allah's servant and the brother of His Messenger. Abu Dharr then testifies to Ali's allegiance, brotherhood, and deputyship, and the narrator confirms that eight other prominent companions bore the same testimony.

en.bilal-muhammad: On this day, Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us. He said: Ja'far b. Salama narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us. He said: `Ubaydullah b. Musa al-'Absi narrated to us. He said: Muhallal al-`Abdi narrated to us. He said: Kadira b. Salih al-Hijri narrated to us from Abi Dharr Jundub b. Junada (ra). He said:

I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say three phrases to `Ali (as); each of which is more beloved to me than this world and all that is in it. I heard him say: O Allah! Assist him and assist others through him. O Allah! Support him and support others through him, for he is Your servant and the brother of Your Messenger. Then, Abu Dharr (rh) said: I bear witness to the allegiance, brotherhood, and deputyship of `Ali.

Kadira b. Salih said: Salman al-Farisi, Miqdad, `Ammar, Jabir b. `Abdullah al-Ansari, Abu Haytham b. al-Tayhan, Khuzayma b. Thabit the Bearer of Two Testimonies, Abu Ayyub the owner of the house of the Messenger of Allah (s), and Hashim b. `Atiyya al-Murqal would also bear witness to that like of that for him. They were all from the best of the companions of the Messenger of Allah (s).
